releaseNotes: Release v37 - Version 5.9: Sprint 8 completed. Delivered zero-sign-in standalone productivity engine (TaskEntity, TaskDao) with TickTick-depth task categorization (Inbox, Work, Personal, Errands), priorities (P1-P4), on-device deterministic NLP conversational parser (TaskNlpParser), two-way CalendarProvider bridge, and full Jetpack Compose ProductivityScreen.

Release v36 - Version 5.8: Sprint 7 completed. Delivered glanceable Android Launcher AppWidgets for Weather, Market, and News with one-tap cellular radio refresh triggers, dynamic opacity frosted-glass theming (40%-100%), and background WorkManager periodic synchronization utilizing 8-hex SHA-256 ETag hashing and 304 NOT MODIFIED zero-data micro-frames.

Release v32 - Version 5.4: Consolidated release including Section 2.10 (Hardware Sensor 2D Physics Game Engine), Section 2.11 (Audio Voice Note Live Recorder & 50Hz Waveform Scrubber), Section 2.13 (Message Thread Forking & Edit Prompt), Section 2.14 (Pluggable Bubble Animation Presets), and Section 2.16 (Procedural 2D Maze Generator with 4 Difficulty Tiers & Seed Reproducibility).

Release v31 - Version 5.3: Includes FEAT-06 Inline Card Iteration & Feed-Tail Re-anchoring, INC-05 Inbound Voice Note MMS Extraction with AMR-NB/WB waveform synthesis, INC-07 Direct Background MMS PDU Egress (eliminating Android App Chooser), and Epic 14 SDUI Primitive Expansion (native Sparkline & Mini-Bar Canvas charts).
Release v30 - Version 5.2: Rollup release for Sprint 3 (Carrier Ingress, Sender Validation, Debounce & 2-Tab Navigation Architecture).

Release v29 - Version 5.1: Implementation of Epic 13.4 and Epic 13.5. Features Market Ticker Interactive Input & In-Place Reconciliation (keyed in-place mutation, loading shimmer) and Genesis Protocol System Prompt & AI Runtime Contract (preamble injection and compact diagnostic payloads on fresh sessions).
Release v28 - Version 5.0: Carrier Telephony Ingestion & Fault-Tolerant Transport Architecture.
